reproduction: Use this exact cwd, absolute interpreter and command-local PYTHONPATH, choosing a fresh nonexistent build/q24_s16_l13_l12_parent_coordinate_cut_* output directory. The command compiles both touched Python files, collects and executes the 18 focused tests once, then runs the diagnostic once. Use the operator-required durable runner for this longer-than-two-minute command. Existing output is never replaced. No accepted L0-L8 tests or layer computations are replayed.
interventions: Deterministic order: actual baseline, all-mapped control, singleton indices 0..895, then 28 contiguous ascending 32-coordinate shards each immediately followed by its 864-coordinate complement. Each control starts from the same authenticated actual L12 parent, copying all I/Z/H fields together at precisely the selected coordinates. Complement means all coordinates outside that shard are mapped; it is not a separately propagated or relifted parent.
mapping: Reuse the reviewed exact rational nearest-Q24 ties-even mapping of the independently propagated original-input L12 binary64 vector; preserve negative zero and derive H by independent exact RNE16 projection. Assert bitwise equality to the reviewed mapped parent and a per-coordinate mapping error <= 2^-25. This counterfactual never replaces the original-input L13 global reference.
authentication: Bind the pinned reviewed a816 result, every input/artifact/validation/source binding and the retained attempt002 freeze. Reuse the retained diagnostic's source, weight, operand, parent receipt, state, local-reference and own-empty-P0 KV authentication. Assert the full L9-L13 original-reference parent chain without executing L9-L12. Replay only actual and mapped native L13 endpoints against reviewed archives and unchanged gate reports. Recheck bound inputs and loaded repository module origins at completion.

thresholds.S18: Unchanged binary64-fp16-excess-v1: exact actual error minus nearest-FP16 representation floor <= 1/8, against the original-input independently propagated global reference.

gates: Every one of the 954 controls executes all 19 native L13 stages and all unchanged mandatory gates, with exact paired-state, actual-operand, native S16 RTZ and own-layer empty P0 KV checks. Numerical failures are retained, not bypassed; invalid lineage/source/state/operands or missing checks block. Scalar rescue and all-L13-gates-pass are reported separately; no counterfactual is admitted or published.
classification: Any accepted singleton is conditional single-coordinate sufficiency; absent that, an accepted shard or complement is bounded shard sufficiency; absent both, the reproduced full-parent rescue leaves subset interactions unresolved. Record all accepted output words, including words other than 662f. Never infer a unique upstream producer or exhaustive interaction attribution from these controls.
